label: Conversion rate
description: Share of visitors / leads / sessions that complete a target action (purchase, sign-up, qualified opportunity).

label: Cart abandonment rate
description: Share of initiated carts / checkouts that are not completed.

label: Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
description: Customer-reported satisfaction with interaction, purchase, or product.

label: Average order value (AOV)
description: Average revenue per completed transaction.

label: Online revenue
description: Gross e-commerce / digital channel revenue.

label: Product return rate
description: Share of shipped units returned or exchanged.

label: Campaign throughput
description: Number of campaigns or creative assets shipped per period.

label: Content / brief cycle time
description: Elapsed time from brief request to publishable creative or content.

label: Pipeline coverage ratio
description: Open pipeline value as a multiple of quota for the upcoming period.

label: Qualified meetings booked
description: Number of qualified discovery meetings or demos booked per period / per rep.

label: Social-channel response time
description: Median time from inbound social mention / DM to brand response.

label: Price realization
description: Actual selling price as a share of list price across orders.

label: Gross margin
description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold, as a share of revenue.

label: Marketing ROI / mROI
description: Incremental revenue or contribution generated per marketing dollar spent.

label: Share of voice in AI / LLM answers
description: Share of LLM-generated answers, recommendations, or shopping responses in which the brand or product is surfaced.

label: Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
description: Share of inbound leads that convert to qualified opportunities.

label: Customer churn rate
description: Share of customers (or revenue) lost over a period through cancellations, non-renewals, or attrition.

label: Sales win rate
description: Share of qualified opportunities that close-won.

label: Rep ramp time
description: Elapsed time from new-hire start date to productive quota attainment.

label: Procurement cycle time
description: Elapsed time from request initiation to PO placement / contract signed.

label: Accounts-payable cycle time
description: Elapsed time from invoice receipt to payment scheduled.

label: Document / data processing error rate
description: Share of records (invoices, forms, transcripts) with extraction or validation errors.

label: Inbound triage time
description: Median time from inbound message arrival to routing into the correct queue or workflow.

label: Analyst throughput
description: Number of analyses / reports produced per analyst per period.

label: CRM / data-completeness score
description: Share of expected fields populated across a dataset (e.g., CRM records, customer profiles).

label: SLA compliance rate
description: Share of work items completed within the target service-level agreement.

label: Time to insight
description: Elapsed time from a knowledge question to a usable, grounded answer or analysis.

label: Meeting time saved
description: Aggregate hours saved by automating meeting prep, notes, action items, and follow-ups.

label: Time saved per employee
description: Hours per employee per period reclaimed by AI productivity tooling.

label: Cost savings
description: Hard-dollar cost reduction attributable to AI automation, deflection, or efficiency.

label: Self-service deflection rate
description: Share of support / helpdesk interactions resolved without escalating to a human.

label: Signature cycle time
description: Elapsed time from document send to fully executed signature.

label: Data-quality incidents
description: Count of data-quality issues caught (or escaped) per period across monitored pipelines.

label: Process cycle time
description: End-to-end elapsed time for a tracked business process.

label: LLM hallucination rate
description: Share of LLM responses scored as ungrounded / inaccurate against a reference.

label: AI feature time-to-deploy
description: Elapsed time from idea to production deployment of an AI capability.

label: Fraud detection rate
description: Share of fraudulent transactions correctly identified before settlement.

label: False-positive rate
description: Share of legitimate transactions / events incorrectly flagged as suspicious.

label: Financial close cycle time
description: Calendar days from period end to close completion.

label: Compliance review / approval cycle time
description: Elapsed time for a compliance check (KYC, AML, regulatory review) to complete.

label: Accounts-receivable cycle time
description: Elapsed time from invoice issued to payment received and matched.

label: Cash-position accuracy
description: Variance between predicted and actual cash position over a near-term horizon.

label: Audit prep / cycle time
description: Elapsed time from audit kick-off to evidence-ready / sign-off.

label: Loan / credit decision time
description: Elapsed time from credit application submission to approval / denial.

label: Loan default rate
description: Share of issued credit that defaults within the observation period.

label: Property valuation accuracy
description: Variance between AVM-predicted property value and actual transaction price.

label: Time to hire
description: Calendar days from requisition open to offer accepted.

label: Diverse / atypical hire share
description: Share of hires that meet diversity / atypical-profile targets.

label: Training engagement
description: Completion rate or active participation in learning programs.

label: Onboarding time-to-productivity
description: Calendar days from start date to baseline productive output.

label: Internal-fill rate
description: Share of open roles filled by internal candidates.

label: Employee retention rate
description: Share of employees retained over a defined period (inverse of attrition).

label: Employee engagement score
description: Composite engagement metric from pulse/sentiment signals.

label: Skills coverage vs. demand
description: Share of required skills covered by current workforce capabilities.

label: Performance-review throughput
description: Calibrated reviews completed per period per manager.

label: Model fairness score
description: Composite disparate-impact / counterfactual-fairness metric for AI decisions.

label: Document review cycle time
description: Elapsed time to review a defined batch of contracts, discovery documents, or filings.

label: Legal research cycle time
description: Elapsed time from question posed to research memo / answer delivered.

label: Client / matter intake cycle time
description: Elapsed time from lead arrival to engaged matter.

label: Average handle time (AHT)
description: Average duration of a contact-center interaction (call, chat, ticket).

label: First-contact resolution rate
description: Share of contacts resolved on the first interaction without escalation or return.

label: Net Promoter Score (NPS)
description: Likelihood-to-recommend metric from customer surveys.

label: Escalation rate
description: Share of tickets escalated from Tier-1 to higher-skill queues.

label: Call answer rate
description: Share of inbound calls answered (vs. abandoned / unanswered).

label: Alert triage time
description: Median time from alert generation to analyst-disposition decision.

label: Mean time to detect (MTTD)
description: Average elapsed time from threat presence to detection.

label: Mean time to respond (MTTR)
description: Average elapsed time from detection to containment / remediation.

label: Account-takeover incident rate
description: Count or share of accounts compromised by ATO per period.

label: PR cycle time
description: Elapsed time from pull-request open to merged.

label: Code review time
description: Elapsed time from PR ready-for-review to first complete review.

label: Bug triage time
description: Elapsed time from bug report to assigned-and-prioritized.

label: Unplanned downtime rate
description: Share of available equipment time lost to unplanned stoppages.

label: Inventory turnover
description: Ratio of cost-of-goods-sold to average inventory; higher = leaner inventory.

label: Stockout rate
description: Share of SKUs or order lines unavailable when ordered.

label: Supplier-risk score coverage
description: Share of suppliers under active risk monitoring with a current score.

label: Delivery / ETA accuracy
description: Variance between predicted and actual delivery time.

label: Crop yield
description: Output per unit of farmland over a growing season.

label: Workplace-incident rate
description: Recordable incidents per worker-hour or per period.

label: Claims cycle time
description: Elapsed time from claim first-notice-of-loss to resolution / payout.

label: Underwriting cycle time
description: Elapsed time from application submitted to underwriting decision.

label: Straight-through-processing rate
description: Share of policies / claims completed without manual intervention.

label: Prior-auth cycle time
description: Elapsed time from prior-auth request to decision.

label: Drug discovery cycle time
description: Elapsed time from target identification to lead candidate (or to clinical entry).

label: Phase I clinical success rate
description: Share of candidates that advance past Phase I trials.

label: Time-to-test (audience / creative research)
description: Elapsed time from concept to read-out on audience / message research.

label: Part weight / mass reduction
description: Reduction in part weight or material vs. baseline design, holding performance constant.

label: Model accuracy
description: Accuracy / F1 / AUC of a deployed ML model against a held-out reference set.

label: Model / training-data coverage
description: Breadth of intents, edge cases, or sub-populations the model is trained or validated to handle.

label: Network uptime / SLA performance
description: Share of time the network meets its uptime and SLA targets.

label: Demand / generation forecast accuracy
description: Variance between predicted and actual demand / renewable generation.

label: Carbon intensity / emissions
description: Emissions per unit of output (kWh, $, ton); tracks decarbonization progress.

label: Wells drilled per period
description: Wells brought online per quarter / year, holding capital constant.

label: Process yield
description: Share of input converted to spec-meeting output in a refining / manufacturing process.

label: EV charging coverage
description: Share of population, road-miles, or grid territory within reach of an EV charger.

label: Student mastery / test-score gain
description: Improvement in measured mastery or test scores attributable to AI-augmented learning.

label: Viewer engagement
description: Watch time, completion rate, interaction rate, or return rate on content.

label: Academic-integrity detection rate
description: Share of suspicious or non-policy-compliant submissions correctly flagged.

label: Content-moderation accuracy
description: Precision / recall of content-moderation classifiers on a labeled benchmark.

label: Captioning / accessibility coverage
description: Share of content shipped with captions, translations, or accessibility metadata.

label: Attendance / occupancy accuracy
description: Accuracy of automated attendance vs. ground-truth roll.

label: Inspection throughput
description: Inspections completed per inspector or per period.

label: Enforcement coverage
description: Share of road-miles / parking zones / tolls covered by automated enforcement.

label: Diagnostic accuracy
description: Sensitivity / specificity of AI-assisted diagnosis vs. ground truth.

label: Appointment fill rate
description: Share of available appointment slots filled.

label: Care-level routing accuracy
description: Share of patients routed to the correct care level by triage AI.

label: Claim denial rate
description: Share of submitted medical claims denied on first submission.

label: Chronic-care adherence
description: Share of patients meeting chronic-care self-management targets.

label: Vitals / activity monitoring coverage
description: Share of cohort with continuous monitoring active and producing usable signal.

label: Clinical risk-prediction accuracy
description: Calibration / AUC of clinical risk predictions (readmission, sepsis, falls, flares).

label: Retail shrinkage rate
description: Inventory loss (theft, damage, mis-counts) as a share of revenue or stock value.

label: Debt-recovery rate
description: Share of outstanding debt collected within the recovery window.

label: ESG disclosure coverage
description: Share of required ESG / sustainability disclosures populated with auditable, current data.

label: Outbreak / anomaly detection lead time
description: Days of advance warning between AI-detected anomaly signal and conventional surveillance confirmation.

label: Field-service first-call resolution
description: Share of dispatches resolved on the first technician visit.
